items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: That guy, a comedian, he called Ben, his name was Benjamin too, but he called him Ben for short, you see.

ctx.x: They had Smilinger in the picture and all these different women.

They were playing floor shows there. They had floor shows at the time. I see. That guy, a comedian, he called Ben, his name was Benjamin too, but he called him Ben for short, you see. And Dejon's sister, she was in the floor show. She was in the floor show. She was in the floor show. I had a good minute of playing the floor show.
What was the floor show on?
